string-array.item: No Steam Web API key: only installed games are visible

string-array.name: first_run_check_fixes
string-array.item: Start Vibepollo on the PC. If it is still missing, open Host Control and use \"Repair\".
The game library comes from the host. Open Host Control and use \"Repair\".

Without a key only games installed on the PC show. With one, your whole Steam library.

1. Scan the code with your phone and copy the key.
2. On the PC: Host Control › Integrations › Steam.
3. Paste the key and save. This row turns green.
On the PC: Host Control › Integrations › Epic › Sign in.
So a locked PC signs in by itself: on the PC, Host Control › Remote sign-in. The Windows password stays on the PC.
OK puts the PC to sleep and wakes it with Wake-on-LAN. If it does not wake, turn on Wake-on-LAN in the BIOS and in the network adapter settings.
